info.title: Barbershop Booking API
info.description:
Public booking API (services, staff, availability, booking requests, email-link
pages, demo payments), customer account API (/api/me), barber API (/api/barber)
and admin API (/api/admin). Access tokens are short-lived JWTs (Bearer); the
refresh token is an httpOnly cookie on /api/auth.
Customer-facing texts are localized: `?lang=de|en` or the `Accept-Language`
header (default `de`). Times are ISO-8601 with the offset of the tenant's timezone.
Errors are RFC 9457 problem details with a stable `code`.
Payments: DEMO MODE ONLY — no real payment provider is connected.

put.summary: Replace the booking policy (all values in minutes / cents / percent)

post.summary: Request a booking (guest or logged-in) → 201, status PENDING_BARBER. 409 if the slot was just taken, 422 if it is not a valid slot. The manage link is sent by email only.
Price before booking: total, loyalty discount (logged-in customers), deposit, due at shop
Register a customer account (consent required). Always 202 — check your email.
DEMO ONLY: simulate a successful payment → CONFIRMED. Goes through the same PaymentService.handlePaymentSucceeded a real webhook uses. Idempotent.
Customer cancels the booking from the payment page (nothing was paid)
Provider webhook (real providers only; the demo provider has none → 404)
Cancel via the manage link (single use). Deposit refunded if ≥ refund cutoff before
Fresh single-use link to the deposit payment page (only while AWAITING_PAYMENT)
Decline → DECLINED, customer is asked to pick another time (single use)
Accept → AWAITING_PAYMENT, customer gets the payment link (single use)
Confirm the email (single-use link token). Links earlier guest bookings with that email.
Set a new password with the reset/invite link token (single use). Ends all sessions.
GDPR: delete my account (password required). Open future bookings are cancelled, all bookings anonymised.
"Pay now": fresh single-use link to the deposit payment page (only while AWAITING_PAYMENT)
Cancel my booking (deposit refunded if ≥ refund cutoff before the appointment)
Cancel by the shop: a paid deposit is always refunded
Login (customer, barber or admin) → access token + refresh cookie. The same 401 for unknown email / wrong password / locked account; 403 auth.email_not_verified only after a correct password.
New access token from the refresh cookie (rotates the cookie; reuse revokes the session)
Change password: all other sessions end, this device gets a fresh session + cookie
Ends this session (revokes the refresh token family, clears the cookie). Idempotent.

get.summary: Time off overlapping [from, to) — default: now … +90 days

post.summary: Create the barber's own login for this staff profile; an invite email lets them set their password

get.summary: List/filter bookings. Dates are local days in the shop timezone; q searches name, email, phone; sort = startTime|createdAt|customerName|status, prefix '-' for desc

post.summary: Manual booking (walk-in / phone): CONFIRMED immediately, no deposit
Refund override: refunds a PAID or FORFEITED deposit (simulated in demo mode)
Cancel by the shop. A paid deposit is refunded by default; refund=false keeps it

get.summary: Shop info (name, timezone, currency, theme) and the booking rules customers see
Active barbers, localized bio; ?service= filters to those offering it

One day for ALL barbers at once: a column per barber with every start time of their schedule (available=false = taken) plus the merged 'any barber' list (free only). services = comma-separated service ids; duration = sum of all services.
Dates in [from, to] with at least one free slot (max. 62 days); staff omitted = any barber
Payment page data: amount, booking summary, demoMode flag (changes nothing). 410 token.used (with paymentStatus) / token.expired
Booking behind a manage link (changes nothing). 410 token.used / token.expired
Live status for the status page (statusToken from the creation response; changes nothing)
Request behind the barber's accept/decline link (changes nothing)
GDPR: everything stored about me as JSON (download)
My bookings: scope=upcoming (default, soonest first) or past (latest first)
My calendar: view=day (default) or week (Mon–Sun containing date)
Bookings per day and per service (default: last 30 days)
Customers (accounts + guests by email) with completed visits and loyalty state
